Marissa / Camila

— notes and suggested language we can provide to FinBank: 

1) In-transit encryption: all network traffic to Redwood services is encrypted using TLS 1.2+ (we recommend TLS 1.3 where supported). Mutual TLS is available for Dedicated/Private deployments on request.

2) At-rest encryption: data at rest is encrypted using AES-256-GCM. Customer data in hosted environments is encrypted at the storage layer and additionally encrypted per-customer in Dedicated/Private with optional envelope encryption.

3) Customer-managed keys (BYOK): Redwood supports CMK workflows with major cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault) for key wrapping in hosted and dedicated modes. For Private/on-prem deployments we support integration with customer HSMs (bring-your-own-HSM) and HSM-backed key wrapping.

4) HSM-backed options: For higher assurance, Private deployments can use FIPS 140-2/140-3 validated HSMs (e.g., Thales Luna or AWS CloudHSM) for key material. We can support key import or have customers generate keys directly in the HSM.

5) Key lifecycle & ops: key rotation is supported via KMS rotation policies; we surface key metadata in audit logs. Export of plaintext keys is not supported; key material remains under customer control when using CMK/HSM. Separation of duties and role-based access controls are enforced in our control plane.

6) Audit / telemetry: key usage (encrypt/decrypt/wrap/unwrap) events are logged and can be exported to customer SIEMs (CloudWatch/Stackdriver/Splunk) for Dedicated/Private. Hosted customers can request tailored log exports under contract.

7) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025. We can provide the report under NDA; Camila can coordinate the NDA + secure transfer.

Suggested next steps to FinBank:
- We'll send a short security overview PDF and a completed vendor questionnaire draft by EOD Thursday.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with our infra/security engineers (proposed 26 May, 11am PT).
- If needed, we can provide a short demo of CMK setup for AWS KMS / CloudHSM on a staging tenant during the call.

I can populate the questionnaire sections related to crypto/key mgmt/audit. Camila

— can you attach the SOC 2 attestation stub and coordinate NDA?


— Aditya
